caseStudies.title: System Design: BookMyShow — Movie Ticket Booking (LLD + HLD)
caseStudies.summary: Hold-then-confirm with an atomic Redis claim, dual expiry, and idempotent payment confirmation. The whole round is one concurrency question.

caseStudies.title: System Design: URL Shortener (HLD Round)
caseStudies.summary: Seven Base62 characters, pre-allocated counter ranges, and a Feistel scramble — because multiply-by-a-constant leaks your entire key space.

caseStudies.subtitle: Selling 10,000 units to 2 million people in sixty seconds without overselling one.
